crossRefs.note: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.
When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”
When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

translations.web: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’
translations.bsb: And he called in each one of his master’s debtors. ‘How much do you owe my master?’ he asked the first.
translations.kjv: So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
translations.asv: And calling to him each one of his lord's debtors, he said to the first, How much owest thou unto my lord?
